name: svg-draw-on-scroll
title: SVG Draw On Scroll
description: A single curvy line that draws itself from start to finish as its container scrolls, with a glowing dot riding the growing tip and small tags pinned beside the route.
use: A trip, timeline or process page wants a route to unfold in step with the reader's scrolling.
avoid: It needs a scrollable ancestor and a tall sized box, and the drawing is hidden from assistive tech.
a11y: The SVGs are aria-hidden, so the route and its stops have no accessible description beyond the text tags. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: respected)
looks: On black, a thin white line snakes down through four broad curves to the bottom. Four small rounded tags label the stops, and a bright pink dot with a soft halo sits on the stroke's current end.
behaves: Scrolling longerens the stroke from the top while the dot tracks its tip and the stop tags hold their places. Scrolling back shortens the line again unless the run-once option freezes it fully drawn.
customise: Path data, an optional set of paths, viewBox, stroke colour and width, scroll offset, run-once, the marker node and the scroll container are all props.
weight: light: One stroke and one marker following a spring while scrolling; still when parked.
